C200.notes: SER AS-TW-001. Both-sides photos · user shorthand Both sides of one coin. Obverse Chiang Kai-shek left · 中華民國六十七年 (Republic of China Year 67 = 1978 Gregorian). Reverse 壹圓 · 1. Everyday Taiwan dollar of the late Chiang era — wet-market / bus / night-market weight. Country #29 — first Taiwan / ROC · second East Asia after Hong Kong C146. Taiwan flips now 1.

open_questions: Type record files a 1978 Taiwan 1 yuan as KM#551/Y#551, but Y#551 is the 1981+ aluminum-bronze type; the 1978 (ROC year 67) 1 yuan is Y#536 (Numista and NGC agree). Is the type attribution wrong? Verify against the physical coin or photo.

C200.story: A 1978 1 yuan from Taiwan (ROC). The obverse shows Chiang Kai-shek left; the reverse shows 壹圓; 中華民國六十七年 (ROC Year 67 = 1978), 1. Struck in copper-nickel / bronze-tone.
